summary.headline: Samyung ENC amends KRW 13.2bn defense radio supply contract after scope reduction
summary.what_happened: Samyung ENC Co., Ltd. filed a corrected disclosure for its single supply contract with the Defense Acquisition Program Administration (방위사업청) for a short-wave communication system. The contract amount was revised from KRW 13,268,000,000 to KRW 13,248,885,115 (about KRW 13.2bn) due to a change in the contract, including the closure of a wireless DMHF communication network that reduced the scope of supply.
summary.why_it_matters: In Korea, corrected supply-contract filings typically indicate that the value or scope of a previously disclosed contract has changed, which can affect the revenue expectations that investors may have associated with it. Shareholders usually review such corrections to understand the revised contract size and any conditions attached to it.
